heroSummary: Mesa Public Schools starts the 2027–28 school year on Wednesday, July 28, 2027. Fall Break runs October 4–8, Winter Break runs December 20–31 with students still out on January 3, Spring Break runs March 6–17, and the last day of school and graduation date on the calendar is Thursday, May 25, 2028.
calendarNotes: The MPS 2027–28 calendar lists 180 total student days. It uses a July start, a full fall break, a long winter break, a two-week spring break window, professional learning days, and a May last day.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Mesa Public Schools start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Mesa Public Schools starts the 2027–28 school year on Wednesday, July 28, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break for Mesa Public Schools in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break is shown as March 6–17, 2028, on the reviewed MPS calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the MPS 2027–28 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The reviewed Mesa Public Schools calendar lists 180 total student days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later MPS revisions.

customSections.content: The 2027–28 MPS calendar uses a July opening date and a long March break window. Families moving from districts with a later start should plan for school to begin before August.
